chapter_title_en: The Return of the Sword Immortal
chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning Returns to Anchan: A Master's Tribulation and a Commandery in Flames
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning returns to Anchan City to find a commandery in turmoil, his old friends alive but weakened, and his master preparing for the most dangerous step of all—the Heavenly Tribulation.
og_description: Anchan Commandery is in chaos, old rivals live on under a new Marquis, and the Diancai Immortal prepares for his ultimate trial!
twitter_title: Back in Anchan – Chaos, Clans & Tribulation
twitter_description: Ji Ning's homecoming reveals a world on edge: Beishan Baiwei is safe, Black-White College is booming, and a master's tribulation looms.

lore_anchors.definition: A powerful Celestial Immortal under the Beishan clan of Anchan, known for his hunched back and wooden staff; serves as the clan's top intelligence figure and diplomatic envoy.
The slovenly, short old man Senior Apprentice-Brother of the Diancai Immortal; the oldest Loose Immortal of the Black-White College.
The new Marquis of Anchan, who surprisingly spared his rival Beishan Heihu and his son Beishan Baiwei after winning the clan succession struggle.
The father of Beishan Baiwei and the former primary rival to Beishan Yin in the struggle for the Marquis title; still living in his old estate in Anchan City.
Former College Lord of the Black-White College; a Primal Daoist who recently broke through to become an Earth Immortal.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Beishan Heihu still alive and living in Anchan City after losing the succession war?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In typical Xianxia clan politics, the loser is exiled or killed, but Beishan Yin's unusual leniency suggests either a strategic calculation (keeping a visible but powerless rival placates old loyalists) or genuine magnanimity that sets him apart from standard tyrannical rulers.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What makes Ji Ning's apprenticeship so mysterious that even Celestial Immortals are curious?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He refused the direct invitation of a Crimsonbright Daofather Immortal and vanished for over thirty years—during which no known power admitted to taking him as a disciple. This implies a teacher powerful and secretive enough to defy a Daofather's implied claim, which is a massive deal in the Three Realms.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the Diancai Immortal's tribulation mentioned here a sign he will die?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In Xianxia, a tribulation announcement is almost never a death sentence—it's a narrative lever. The setup signals that a major power-up or a desperate sacrifice is incoming, and it's a classic way to raise emotional stakes for the disciple (Ji Ning) who cares about him.
